title: Berceuse
identity: Alphonse Leduc HL48181353 / AL20803 is Marcel Perrin’s Berceuse for alto saxophone and piano, three pages. An online performance page credits saxophonist Efrem Roca and identifies the original score as Leduc.

evidence.claim: Sheet Music Plus gives composer, alto saxophone and piano, Leduc AL20803, and 3 pages.
Video page credits saxophonist Efrem Roca and identifies the Leduc original score.
Quebec conservatory syllabus lists Perrin Berceuse in a collection of simple, songful works for tone study.
evidence.source_name: Conservatoire de musique et d’art dramatique du Québec

review_focus: Inference: the conservatory’s documented use for tone study is a concrete lens for checking sustained sound and phrase shaping in the printed part.
